verdicts.originalText: Base duration is 712f (11.87s from cast start, i.e. 10s active after the burst animation). Each in-stance Mortuary Rite cast extends the window by 4s (max 2×, up to ~19.87s total) via `durationExtensions[]`.
verdicts.rationale: The caveat states no omission or divergence — it explains the burst's duration breakdown (kit mechanics) and the 4s×2 extension, which is modeled correctly via durationExtensions on the onCast skill trigger (CAN list: durationExtensions onCast is wired). It also carries banned content (frame count 712f, backticked field name). Describes working behavior + curator sourcing, so it costs the user no true warning.

verdicts.originalText: C2 grants up to 5 stacks of +10% Electro DMG Bonus (50% total), each refreshed by normal hits with a 0.1s ICD. During Pactsworn Pathclearer, stacks reach and hold max almost immediately. Stack dynamics are not modelled in the planner.
verdicts.proposedText: Not modeled: the Electro DMG Bonus stacks (up to 5 × 10%, 50% total), refreshed by normal hits with a 0.1s ICD. During the burst they reach and hold max almost immediately.
verdicts.rationale: The constellation has no effects authored, so the stacks are genuinely not modeled (not implementDelete — the data isn't wired for this character). Kept the decision-relevant point that stacks max out almost instantly during the burst, so the omission is low-impact. Fixed 'modelled', dropped 'in the planner', dropped the redundant C2 chip and the burst-state proper noun ('during the burst' per same-character kind-only rule). All claims preserved.
